pe_prompt:
For the target video, at 0.00 seconds into the target video, <Picture 1> (from [Shot 1]) is fully referenced.

integrated_multimodal_description: [Shot 1] Live-action, cinematic in 1980s Shaw Brothers wuxia film style — moderate saturation, heavy old-film grain, hard vintage lighting, warm night courtyard with blurred red lanterns. A medium close-up frames the silver-grey tabby cat (human-scaled, clear fur texture, no green bow tie) exactly as in <Picture 1>: paw raised toward the glossy sauce-braised duck tied with hemp rope to the wooden post, mouth open in a fierce glare, duck head drooping. The camera holds a static shot as the standoff continues, and a honest tan Shiba Inu slowly enters the frame edge and sits nearby, watching blankly. The fierce cat (S1) says in an off-screen voiceover: <d>[Chinese] 说！不说？不说我挠你！</d> while its lips remain completely closed. [Shot 2] At 00:02.000, the shot cuts to a side medium close-up, fixed camera, cat and duck in profile. The cat jabs its paw toward the duck with a fierce expression; the duck slumps deeper against the rope, helpless. The fierce cat (S1) says in an off-screen voiceover: <d>[Chinese] 说！不说？不说我挠你！</d> while all lips remain completely closed. [Shot 3] At 00:05.000, the shot cuts to an eye-level close-up of the duck's face, glossy braised skin trembling, eyes wet and aggrieved. The aggrieved duck (S2) says in an off-screen voiceover: <d>[Chinese] 让我说什么啊？打了我三天都没说让我说什么！</d> while its beak remains completely closed. [Shot 4] At 00:08.000, the shot cuts to a side medium close-up, fixed camera; the cat snaps its head toward the blank-faced Shiba Inu, confused. The confused cat (S1) says in an off-screen voiceover: <d>[Chinese] 那你说，它到底要说什么？</d> while its lips remain completely closed. [Shot 5] At 00:11.000, the shot cuts to a wide eye-level static shot with cat, dog, and duck all in frame under lantern light; the dog stares into space. The deadpan Shiba Inu (S3) says in an off-screen voiceover: <d>[Chinese] 我哪知道啊……</d> while its mouth remains completely closed. [Shot 6] At 00:13.000, the shot cuts to a quick push-in on the cat's face in close-up; the cat freezes completely, eyes vacant and unfocused, ending on the frozen expression.

overall_soundscape: Light ambient night-courtyard sounds with faint wind and rope creaking as the duck shifts. Paw gestures and fabric movement stay subtle; the final push-in ends in total stillness.

non_diegetic_music: Upbeat retro Shaw-style wuxia score with punchy percussion, softening under shot 4, turning comic and playful in shot 5, then cutting off abruptly at shot 6 with a comedic descending-scale sting.
